name: project-guardian
description: Project Guardian — package security auditing and management for Windows.
author: Lupus Venture

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter @workspace/package-guard dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false USE_HARD_LINKS=false NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "@workspace/package-guard" --filter "./tools/scripts" --if-present run typecheck
